description: This line plot illustrates the training loss evolution over iterations for five different model configurations, with the y-axis representing "Loss" on a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, and the x-axis representing "#Iteration" on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 140,000. The legend identifies the five lines: "Vanilla" (purple, solid line), "StrmLLM (n=64)" (blue, solid line), "SepLLM (n=64)" (orange, solid line), "SepLLM (n=64, H)" (green, solid line), and "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" (red, solid line), and "SepLLM (n=128)" (dark blue, solid line). All lines start at a high loss value near 3.4 at iteration 0 and exhibit a rapid initial decline, followed by a slower, more gradual decrease toward a plateau. The "Vanilla" model begins at approximately 3.4 and ends at around 2.45. The "StrmLLM (n=64)" model starts at approximately 3.4 and ends at around 2.65. The "SepLLM (n=64)" model starts at approximately 3.35 and ends at around 2.55. The "SepLLM (n=64, H)" model starts at approximately 3.35 and ends at around 2.5. The "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" model starts at approximately 3.35 and ends at around 2.5. The "SepLLM (n=128)" model starts at approximately 3.4 and ends at around 2.55. All lines are solid with no markers, and their values decrease monotonically over the iterations shown.
